cenarios_cobertos: renders the selected day as data-selected
moves focus across the grid with arrow keys
navigates to the next month with the next button
testes.nota: First 3 scenarios failed on the first try, all for the same root cause: the grid's <td role="gridcell"> is not the interactive element — a nested <div role="button"> with a full-date aria-label (e.g. "Monday, January 15, 2024") is what actually receives clicks/focus and carries data-selected. Also, the grid's own <table> uses role="application", not role="grid" as assumed. Rewrote every scenario to target the inner button by its date label instead of the gridcell — confirmed via a direct probe of the rendered DOM before rewriting.

checklist.roles_aria_corretos: ✅ table role=application, td role=gridcell, day trigger role=button com aria-label de data completa (ex.: "Monday, January 15, 2024")
